---
name: Bug report
about: Reproduce a QuickSend problem without sharing private data
---

Describe the expected and actual behavior, steps to reproduce, extension version, browser/version, and whether this was the extension or HTTP preview. Include redacted errors or screenshots if useful.

Do not include invitation/pairing codes, bearer tokens, room keys, backups, private links/notes, or account credentials. For security-sensitive reports, avoid public issue details; use a private reporting channel offered by the repository owner.
